name: Late gate touch: brush Course 1's start gate from the far side
techNote: The lab's one shape is a 40x40 Ground box buried in the floor (a lab needs a shape); it stands on Course 1's floor right of its start gate (the gate's trigger x 2468-2518, y -343 to -93 in the world frame; the anchor is its centre), facing it, the hitbox's left edge 1.5 u from it. The course timer starts on the first tick the player overlaps the gate, so a route that got to the far side untimed starts it only when it brushes the gate: rest, tap the stick toward the gate for a tick and back, and the hitbox touches the gate for a tick (the finish box is the gate).
